# Stable Diffusion v1.5

Stability AI · released 2022-10 · creativeml-openrail-m

**score 27.2** ±1.8 · #108 of 113 · from 5 benchmark results across 5 sources

Score within the [LMArena text-to-image](https://whatmodel.sh/image?set=lmarena-image&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
version             needs  score
fp16 · nvidia only   ~4GB   27.2
fp32 · mac only      ~8GB   27.2
</pre>

```sh
# fp16 · nvidia only
uv run --with torch --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with safetensors python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5', torch_dtype=torch.float16).to('cuda'); p.enable_attention_slicing(); p('A lighthouse at sunset', height=512, width=512).images[0].save('image.png')"
# fp32 · mac only
uv run --with torch --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with safetensors python -c "from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline; p=StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5').to('mps'); p.enable_attention_slicing(); p('A lighthouse at sunset', height=512, width=512).images[0].save('image.png')"
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
